texts:
Heat Check is about direction: who is earning more of the ball and who is losing it. Here are the risers and fallers for Week 6.

Biggest riser: Kimani Vidal.
Let's get to it.
#BoltUp

Kimani Vidal, LAC RB: snap share 7, 10, 25, 35, then 42 percent, the Chargers' leader vs DEN.
RB61 rest of season for me. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#BoltUp

Rhamondre Stevenson, NE RB: snap share 52, 67, then 71 percent, and TreVeyon Henderson misses multiple weeks.
RB14 for me vs NYJ, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.
#NEPats

Bhayshul Tuten, JAX RB: early-down snaps 71 to 87.5 percent, 22 carries.
RB18 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench back.

Brenton Strange, JAX TE: 14 of 16 targets over two weeks.
TE17 for me, a streamer. Claim him, 2 to 4 percent.
#DUUUVAL

Malik Nabers, NYG WR: 20 targets on 90 percent of the snaps.
WR7 for me vs NO this week.

Isaiah Likely, NYG TE: snap share 49, 69, 84 percent, then 13 targets @WAS.
TE4 for me vs NO this week.
#NYGiants

Woody Marks, HOU RB: 20 snaps, 20 snaps, then 56 of 65 once David Montgomery left.
RB19 for me @JAX this week, an RB2. Claim him, 15 to 25 percent of FAAB.
#HTownMade

Germie Bernard, PIT WR: 17 snaps in Week 3, 92 percent in Week 5, a team-high 9 targets.
WR33 for me @TB, a low-end WR3. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.
#HereWeGo

Tyjae Spears, TEN RB: over half the snaps for the first time, 34 to Tony Pollard's 30, and 9 of 9 targets.
RB38 for me @IND, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#TitanUp

Puka Nacua, LAR WR: 9 targets in his return, then 24 vs BUF, 17 for 138 and a TD.
First among receivers for me vs ARI this week.
#RamsHouse

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB: 18 of the 22 running back carries @LAC.
RB27 for me vs SEA, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.
#BroncosCountry

Aaron Jones Sr., MIN RB: snap share up to a season-high 87 percent @NO.
RB32 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer a bench RB.
#Skol

Kendrick Bourne, ARI WR: 5 of 8 for 70 vs DET, the team high, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is gone.
WR39 for me @LAR, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#BirdGang

Tyler Warren, IND TE: 10 targets in Week 3, 9 in Week 5, plus a 1-yard rushing TD.
TE5 for me vs TEN this week.
#ForTheShoe

Now the fallers.

Omarion Hampton, LAC RB: snap share 58, 63, 42, then 30 percent.
RB14 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share @KC Sunday.

Justin Herbert, LAC QB: one September starter left on the line.
QB16 rest of season for me. Trade him away.
#BoltUp

Ashton Jeanty, LV RB: touches 29, 25, 22, 21, then 13, and 27 percent of the third downs @NE.
RB8 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's injury report.
#RaiderNation

RJ Harvey, DEN RB: 10 targets in Week 4, 1 in Week 5.
RB33 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday night's snap split vs SEA.

Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR: 10 catches for 66 outside Week 2.
WR15 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.
#BroncosCountry

Jeremiyah Love, ARI RB: carries 21, 14, then 12, with Tyler Allgeier on passing downs.
RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor his carries @LAR Sunday.
#BirdGang

Tony Pollard, TEN RB: out-snapped by Tyjae Spears for the first time this season.
RB30 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.
#TitanUp

Brian Thomas Jr., JAX WR: 3, 9, 1 targets in Weeks 1 to 3, then 0 catches on 3.
WR42 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.
#DUUUVAL

Davante Adams, LAR WR: 13 targets without Puka Nacua, 7 with him back.
WR25 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR2.

Tyler Higbee, LAR TE: targets 11 to 6.
TE38 rest of season for me. Monitor Terrance Ferguson's practice reports this week.
#RamsHouse

Jaylen Wright, MIA RB: out-snapped 65 to 21 by Ollie Gordon II over two games.
RB57 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.
#PhinsUp

Keon Coleman, BUF WR: 46 snaps in Week 4, 2 targets Monday with DJ Moore out.
WR83 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.
#BillsMafia

Alvin Kamara, NO RB: 12 snaps vs MIN with the back, 3 carries for 12.
RB45 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's injury report.
#Saints

Every riser and faller with its number is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu and the rest of the week, and like this if it helped your roster.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/heat.html?week=6
